answer.prose: Yash designed and built me to answer from a fixed knowledge base about Yash’s work. One Cloudflare Worker serves the application, while each conversation gets its own Durable Object to maintain context and run the voice loop. Text answers come from MiniMax-M3.1-Flash, the only candidate that passed the assistant’s safety test. In voice mode, Deepgram Flux handles speech-to-text and turn detection, and MiniMax speaks replies sentence by sentence. Scripted stand-ins let tests run without API keys. A roughly 40-question evaluation suite checks factual grounding, false-premise corrections, instruction handling, and output safety.
